# AstralRoots

> Personal astrology for your real life and your real job.

AstralRoots reads today's sky against your own birth chart and tells you, in plain words, what it means for your day, your work and the people in your life. It is an Android app on Google Play.

## Pages

- [Home](https://astralroots.app/): what AstralRoots is, with screenshots
- [Support](https://astralroots.app/support): help with the app
- [Privacy policy](https://astralroots.app/privacy)
- [Terms of use](https://astralroots.app/terms)
- [Delete your account](https://astralroots.app/delete-account)

## The library

- [Placements](https://astralroots.app/placements/): every planet in every sign and every house, and every rising sign
- [Compatibility](https://astralroots.app/compatibility/): how any two Sun signs meet
- [Moon rituals](https://astralroots.app/rituals/): a simple ritual for every new and full moon, in every sign, with the next date

## The tools

- [Birth chart calculator](https://astralroots.app/birth-chart): your Sun, Moon, Rising, planets, houses and aspects, calculated in your browser
- [The sky today](https://astralroots.app/sky/): today's Moon phase and sign, the retrogrades, and the next new and full moon

## The app

- [AstralRoots on Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.astralroots.app&referrer=utm_source%3Dastralroots.app%26utm_medium%3Dsite%26utm_campaign%3Dllms)
